rules: One helper per source collection. A second helper for the same collection is never listed.
interface 'v3' entries are read through get-twin-interface. interface 'v1' entries are the three helpers live before the grant (built with Rapha / Fak.fun) and are read through their own getters.
A collection with no helper has status 'planned', 'screening' or 'manifest-review'. It is shown, but no action buttons are offered and no tool is linked.
legacyPage, when present, is the original hand-built page. It keeps working and stays linked from the shared page.
Counts and coverage are read live from the helper. The 'coverage' block holds only dated snapshots for evidence and must never be presented as live.
